text: JCVI-syn3.0, developed by the Venter group, is a minimal synthetic bacterial genome containing only ___ genes, used to reveal which genes are truly essential for cellular life.
explanation: JCVI-syn3.0 contains just 473 genes, the smallest genome of any known independently replicating organism, built by iteratively removing non-essential genes to empirically define a minimal essential gene set. This effort followed the Venter group's earlier synthesis of the first synthetic bacterial chromosome in 2010.
